evidence.claim: TSMC's 2024 annual report says robust AI-related demand supported growth in leading-edge logic and advanced packaging, and lists CoWoS, InFO, TSMC-SoIC, and silicon photonics as technologies supporting customer needs.

ASML's 2025 annual report says semiconductor growth is being driven by strong demand for AI logic and memory products, which ties ASML's lithography systems to AI-related foundry and memory capacity expansion.

Applied Materials announced a long-term collaboration with SK hynix to develop next-generation DRAM, HBM and NAND solutions for AI systems using Applied's EPIC Center and SK hynix's Boise innovation center.
evidence.source_title: Applied Materials and SK hynix Announce Long-Term R&D Partnership to Accelerate AI Memory Innovation

evidence.claim: Lam Research's December-quarter FY2026 earnings materials state that AI is driving advanced semiconductor investment and that Lam expects its advanced-packaging business to grow more than 40% in calendar 2026.
evidence.source_title: Lam Research Q2 FY2026 Earnings Slides

evidence.claim: KLA's fiscal 2026 second-quarter release says KLA is a key enabler of the AI ecosystem across foundry/logic, memory, advanced packaging and services.
evidence.source_title: KLA Corporation Reports Fiscal 2026 Second Quarter Results

evidence.claim: Onto Innovation disclosed a volume purchase agreement estimated at more than $240 million with a leading HBM manufacturer for Dragonfly 2D inspection and 3D bump metrology to support expansion through 2027.
evidence.source_title: Onto Innovation Reports 2025 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results

evidence.claim: Coherent's fiscal Q3 2026 release says AI datacenter infrastructure continues to scale and that the company is expanding capacity to meet demand.
evidence.source_title: Coherent Corp. Reports Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results

evidence.claim: Lumentum's fiscal Q1 2026 materials cite strength in cloud-focused products, including EML chips, pump lasers, narrow-linewidth laser assemblies for data-center interconnect, and 800G modules.
Flex's fiscal Q4 2026 release says it helps customers accelerate data-center deployment by solving power, heat and scale challenges through power, cooling and scalable IT infrastructure solutions.
evidence.source_title: Flex Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Results

evidence.claim: Johnson Controls' Q1 FY2026 transcript says the company announced two new chiller platforms that extend its position in high-density data-center cooling.
evidence.source_title: Johnson Controls Q1 2026 Earnings Call Transcript

evidence.claim: Carrier's Q1 2026 release says data-center orders were up over 500% and that backlog fully covered expected 2026 data-center sales.
Trane Technologies announced it would acquire LiquidStack to accelerate end-to-end data-center thermal-management solutions and expand liquid-cooling technology for AI workloads.

memory_update.text: TSM should remain the anchor mapping for the advanced-packaging/foundry node; relationship is high-quality but needs market-pricing and capacity-allocation checks because expectations are likely elevated.
ONTO's HBM metrology relationship upgraded from hypothesis to fact because the company disclosed a more than $240 million HBM manufacturer VPA through 2027.
CARR's cooling relationship upgraded because Q1 2026 evidence includes data-center orders up over 500% and 2026 sales coverage from backlog.
TT's cooling relationship strengthened by the LiquidStack acquisition; next layer should test whether liquid-cooling exposure is large enough to move consolidated revenue and margins.
COHR appears to have a more direct AI networking bottleneck relationship than LITE in this chunk due to explicit 800G/1.6T datacenter demand and capacity-expansion commentary.

AMAT, LRCX and KLAC need order-quality decomposition: AI/HBM/advanced-packaging exposure may be real, but total semicap revenue can also be driven by broader foundry, memory, China, and cyclic WFE factors.
FLEX and JCI remain diluted second-order mappings until data-center-specific revenue, backlog, customer concentration, and margin contribution are quantified.

Layer 2C should add market-pricing checks for all 12 names: relative performance since AI-power/cooling/CoWoS narrative acceleration, valuation expansion, estimate revisions, and short-interest changes.

summary: Mapped ticker-to-node relationships for the AI infrastructure semiconductor, optical networking, EMS/power, and data-center cooling candidate chunk. Strongest direct bottleneck mappings are TSMC to leading-edge foundry/CoWoS, ASML to EUV lithography, ONTO to HBM/advanced-packaging metrology, COHR to AI datacenter optics, and CARR/TT to data-center cooling. AMAT, LRCX, and KLAC have broad semicap relationships that require order/backlog segmentation to separate AI-driven demand from cyclic WFE recovery. FLEX and JCI remain valid but more diluted second-order mappings until data-center-specific revenue, backlog, or customer evidence is quantified.
